Home / Courses / Hiragana
Foundation · Available now

Hear it. See it. Recall it.

Hiragana becomes useful when sound and shape connect without romaji or slow translation.

What this course trains

The course introduces small groups of characters, then rotates listening, reading and writing tasks. Older characters return between new ones, and errors come back after a short delay.

Introduction

Hear the sound and meet the character together.

Listening recognition

Hear Japanese and choose the matching Hiragana.

Reading retrieval

See the character and retrieve the sound quickly.

Guided writing

Trace and reproduce the form after recognition begins to stabilize.

Spaced retry

Incorrect items return after other practice instead of repeating immediately.

Why this comes first

Hiragana supports every later course. The target is not reciting a chart; it is recognizing characters inside words and sentences without depending on romaji.
